title: Applications (SSO)
description: Applications that use Compass as single sign-on. Each one has a public identifier and a secret that is shown only once.
caption: Registered applications
col.name: Name
empty.title: No applications registered yet
empty.description: Register an application so its users can sign in with Compass.
rotate.title: Rotate the secret of {{name}}?
rotate.description: The current secret stops working immediately and the application cannot sign in until you configure the new one. The new secret is shown only once.
disable.title: Disable {{name}}?
disable.description: The application will no longer be able to sign in with Compass. It cannot be enabled again: to use it again you will have to register it anew.
register.title: Register application
register.description: Enter the details the application asks for. When you finish you will see its secret once.
form.name: Name
form.nameHelp: This is the name people see when they sign in.
form.redirectUrisHelp: Exact addresses Compass sends the person back to after signing in. Maximum {{max}}.
form.postLogoutRedirectUrisHelp: Where the person goes back to after signing out from the application. Maximum {{max}}.
form.backchannelLogoutUriHelp: Compass notifies this address in the background when a session ends.
form.allowPrivateNetworkBackchannel: Allow the sign-out notice to an internal network
form.allowPrivateNetworkBackchannelHelp: Only the Root can enable it. For safety, notices to internal addresses are blocked by default.
form.refreshJustificationHelp: Without a justification the application does not receive refresh tokens.
form.isExternalHelp: Asks each person for consent before sharing their data with the application.
form.maxRankHelp: Only people of that rank or higher can sign in.
form.maxRankAny: Any active person in the organization
secret.warning: Copy it now: it will not be shown again. Closing this window discards it.
registered.title: Application registered
registered.description: {{name}} can now use Compass to sign in. Configure these values in the application.
rotated.title: Secret rotated
rotated.description: Configure the new secret of {{name}} in the application. The previous one no longer works.
